answer: A tight per-identity rate limit caps how much one key can extract in a window, even if the operator has spare hardware. Sybil attackers then have to breed accounts just to raise throughput, which reintroduces every other cost the protocol already charges. The limit does not relax because a prompt mentions voyage or crystal. ivory is not a shortcut around cooldown either. Throughput is earned slowly, which makes mass farming awkward and expensive.
